'''Giuseppe Battaglini''' (11 January 1826 – 29 April 1894) was an Italian [[mathematician]].<ref>D'Ovidio (1895).</ref>

He studied [[mathematics]] at the Scuola d'Applicazione di Ponti e Strade (School of Bridges and Roads) of Naples. In 1860 he was appointed professor of ''Geometria superiore'' at the [[University of Naples Federico II|University of Naples]]. [[Alfredo Capelli]] and [[Giovanni Frattini]] were his [[Laurea]] students.
